title.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for an event's title.

date.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the date an event is held.

dateHint.defaultMessage: A recurring event is held every week on this date’s day of the week.
dateHint.description: The hint under the date field: what the date means for an event that recurs.

day.description: The heading of the table column for the day of the week an event's date falls on.

recurring.description: The label of the checkbox, and the heading of the table column, for whether an event is held every week.

weeks.description: The label of the field for which weeks of the month a repeating event is held in, each picked from a list.

weeksHint.defaultMessage: For a recurring event: which of the month’s weeks. None picked is every week.
weeksHint.description: The hint under the weeks field: which events it is for, what is picked, and what picking none means.

weeksEmpty.description: What the weeks field shows when no week is picked: the event is held every week.

start.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the time an event starts.

end.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the time an event ends.

image.description: The heading of the table column for the address of an event's picture.

body.description: The label of the rich text editor for what is written about an event, for its own page.

bodyEmpty.defaultMessage: Click to write about the event.
bodyEmpty.description: What stands in for what is written about an event when there is nothing: an invitation to click and start writing.

imageUpload.description: The accessible name of the badge on an event's picture that picks an image to upload, when it has none.

imageChange.description: The accessible name of the badge on an event's picture that picks an image to upload in its place.

imageUploading.description: The accessible name of the upload badge while an event's picture is being uploaded.

imageRemove.description: The accessible name of the badge on an event's picture that removes it.

imageRemoving.description: The accessible name of the remove badge while an event's picture is being removed.

imageConfirm.description: The question asked before an event's picture is removed. `name` is the event's title.

imageInvalid.defaultMessage: That file can’t be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of 4 MB or less.
imageInvalid.description: The error shown when the file picked for an event's picture is not an image of an accepted kind, or is too large.

imageNone.description: What stands in for an event's picture when it has none, said to a reader.
